blocks.text: Match preview: Kenya face Papua New Guinea in 44th Match (ODI) on Sat, 31 Oct, 2026, 12:15 pm at Gymkhana Club Ground Nairobi. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Variable conditions · High 24°C / Low 16°C · Rain: 8.8 mm · Wind: up to 17 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
